'''2014 Alderaan Regionals Adam K LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Adam K]] at [[2014 Alderaan Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Plagueis
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
